args.code: (() => { try { const gc = document.getElementById("game-container"); if (!gc) return JSON.stringify({error: "no game-container"}); const texts = []; gc.querySelectorAll("*").forEach(el => { if (el.children.length === 0 && el.textContent.trim()) { texts.push(el.textContent.trim()); } }); return JSON.stringify({texts: texts.slice(0,60)}); } catch(e) { return JSON.stringify({error: e.message}); } })()
